name: todo2code
description: todo2code (t2c): deterministic intent extraction, evidence graph, OpenRouter document extraction and team summaries, exposed through CLI, MCP and A2A.

scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run verify:no-llm && npm run build && npm test
scripts.demo: node dist/src/cli.js pipeline examples --task task.md --todo TODO.md --changelog CHANGELOG.md --docs 'docs/**/*.md' --no-docs-llm --out .intent-demo
